operation_details.item: The user completed the internal audit walkthrough of accounts payable.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Hey, just wrapped up the internal audit walkthrough of accounts payable. Feels like a weight off my shoulders.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Nice! That's a big chunk of work. How did it go? Any surprises along the way?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Honestly, smoother than I expected. The control matrix we prepared ahead of time really helped keep things on track.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good call being proactive with that matrix. So what's next now that the walkthrough is behind you?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Management is already drafting responses to the audit findings, so I'll be reviewing those soon. And we've got the external auditor meeting scheduled for next week.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Sounds like things are moving quickly. Are you feeling prepared for the external auditor meeting, or still a few loose ends?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I think we're in good shape. The walkthrough cleared up a lot of ambiguity, so I'm actually more confident about the audit than I was a month ago.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That's great to hear. It's nice when a big requirement actually reduces stress instead of adding to it. Let me know if you need any help prepping for the meeting.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Please forget only that I completed the accounts payable walkthrough; keep the control matrix, management response, and auditor meeting.
